proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ _ r hinj hu
  by_contra hr
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (Ideal.span ({r} : Set R)) (Ideal.span_singleton_ne_top hr)
  have hker : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) ≤ P := by
    rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hinj]
    exact bot_le
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hcomap⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral P hker
  have hrP : r ∈ P := hle (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self r)
  rw [← hcomap] at hrP
  exact hQ.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hrP hu)
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (r : R), Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) → IsUnit (algebraMap R S r) → IsUnit r
